.. glosentry:: Docutils

   A Python documentation processing system that can parse
   **reStructuredText** and produce HTML.

.. glosentry:: Pyodide

   A Python distribution compiled to WebAssembly, allowing Python packages to
   run directly inside the browser.

.. glosentry:: directive

   A block-level reStructuredText instruction introduced with ``.. name::``.
   Directives can transform nested content into richer document structures.
